criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark and one world; 5 is best, 4 reads; 6 a flat tray with a seam and UI blocks; 8 a rigid skirt with a sawtooth hem; 1's dark door is the smallest element; 3 reads as a progress bar; 9 the greyest frame.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck with a describable spine; the close lifts 14 points; the reliefs sit outside; one skeleton on nine frames.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the round 1 scope is right. Slide 3's ratio of floors; slide 9 and the caption present a closed list; slide 6 says flatly 'The Texas rows list ... Cortex 2'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Accurate but a company's table; no public body, county, action or deadline; closes on a question the deck can't answer.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays, 5 turns, 9 lands; the cover is document jargon at feed size; 6 and 7 are side branches.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean; a strong caption opener; compliance analyst register elsewhere.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New instrument; concept repeats no. 56; floodlit world repeats no. 55; open question close ran October 20th and 22nd.

one_sentence_fix: Rewrite the cover in the reader's words and give the deck a Texas stake.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat tray, seam, UI blocks, a floating label.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A raking three quarter view of the plate with lit and cast sides; labels seated on their blocks.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Rigid skirt with sawtooth hem; blocks in front of the wheels; car under half the frame.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Soft folds pooling on the deck with contact; blocks under the tyres; camera in.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid grey wall; the dark door smallest and farthest.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Flood off the wall face; the dark door large in the right third.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Three thin bars on an empty slab.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower key, deeper channels, a tighter crop.
